architecture.css_design_system: body { background: #0a0e17; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; } .nav-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 20px 40px; background: rgba(10, 14, 23, 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e293b; } .hero { max-width: 900px; margin: 80px auto; text-align: center; padding: 0 20px; } .project-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; max-width: 1100px; margin: 40px auto; padding: 0 20px; }
